overview_description.description:
mRelief is a Chicago-based all-woman software development team. The company's niche is streamlining social services delivery through eligibility determination for public benefits done through adaptive questionnaires available online and through text messaging.

mRelief is contracted with the City of Chicago to build tools to help low-income parents determine eligibility for early childhood programs. In addition, we have launched the Public Template, a universal tool in private beta that helps program providers generate their own eligibility screeners, view data, and customize response pages.

about_short_description.short_description: mRelief offers an online and SMS tool for low-income Americans to find out if they qualify for social services.

product.name: SNAP Eligibility Screener
product.description: An online and SMS-based tool that helps users determine their eligibility for SNAP benefits.

product.name: Simplified SNAP Application
product.description: Provides users with a streamlined application process for SNAP, available online.

product.name: Application Assistance
product.description: Offers users the option to apply for SNAP with the help of a community partner over the phone.

product.name: Document Upload Assistance
product.description: Aids users in adding required documents to their SNAP application through an easy-to-use uploader.

product.name: CRM for Community Partners
product.description: A CRM tool named Johnnie that helps community organizations increase their outreach to potential SNAP beneficiaries.
